chunks: And how can they seek your judgment when they have the Torah, in which is the judgment of God, then turn away after that? And those are not [truly] believers.

key_terms.التَّوْرَاةُ: The Torah, the holy book of Moses

ai.seo_question: Why did the Jews seek the Prophet's judgment despite having the Torah?
ai.summary: This verse critiques the inconsistency of the Jews who sought the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him and his family) judgment in disputes while possessing the Torah, yet subsequently turned away from it, demonstrating a lack of true faith. In Shia exegesis, this is often linked to the concept of *Tawqif* (divine confirmation) of the Prophet's authority and the idea that true belief requires adherence to the revealed law, not just its possession. The verse underscores the principle that acceptance of divine judgment is a hallmark of genuine belief, a theme central to Shia understanding of the Imams' authority as well.
